region: Marbella, Spain and New York, USA
business_problem: Delivering multi-petabyte financial data to clients across regions and clouds through FTP and ETL pipelines was too slow, siloed, and expensive for RavenPack's growing analytics and AI business.
solution_summary: RavenPack standardized data delivery on Snowflake so client sharing, internal analytics, and AI products all run from one financial repository. Premium market, news, jobs, and alternative datasets are centralized in Snowflake on AWS, replacing fragmented regional pipelines and manual FTP delivery. Snowflake then feeds both direct client sharing and Bigdata.com, RavenPack’s financial research platform, where AI agents pull curated datasets to answer market questions. The same architecture also supports Annotations training datasets for customers building their own large language models. Because RavenPack already runs heavily on AWS, Bigdata.com agents can use AWS Bedrock for reasoning while pulling trusted data from Snowflake, and zero-ETL sharing keeps access fast for clients. Egress Cost Optimizer routes data across 15 regions without dataset duplication, giving RavenPack near-real-time distribution, simpler integration, and a lower-cost path from raw data to AI-ready insight.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Acts as RavenPack's central repository for premium financial and alternative datasets that power sharing and AI products.

solution_components.name: Bigdata.com
solution_components.role: Serves financial research experiences and agents that draw governed datasets directly from Snowflake.

solution_components.name: AWS Bedrock
solution_components.role: Provides model inference for Bigdata.com agents that use Snowflake data to answer financial research questions.

solution_components.name: Egress Cost Optimizer
solution_components.role: Routes shared data efficiently across regions so RavenPack can control global distribution cost.
